node.statement: Combination bridge: split sum_v lambda_jv d_v over the two complementary classes. On the class d_v <= a*tau, nonnegativity of lambda_jv gives sum_{d_v<=a*tau} lambda_jv d_v <= a*tau*L_j. On the class d_v > a*tau, validated node 1.1 gives d_v <= H for every row vertex v, hence sum_{d_v>a*tau} lambda_jv d_v <= H*U_j. Together with node 1.3.1.1, this gives d_j <= sum_v lambda_jv d_v <= a*tau*L_j + H*U_j, while node 1.3.1.2 gives L_j+U_j=1.
